stock.description: Established in 2000 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, Zhenro Services Group Limited specializes in delivering a comprehensive suite of property management solutions across China. The company oversees diverse residential and non-residential properties, providing essential services like cleaning, security, landscaping, and repair and maintenance. These services cater to a broad clientele, including property developers, individual owners, residents, and commercial tenants. Beyond these core offerings, Zhenro Services also provides an extensive range of value-added services. For non-property owners, these encompass sales assistance, bespoke support, housing repair, initial planning and design consultation, and pre-delivery inspections. Additionally, the company offers community-focused value-added services for property owners and residents, including home-living amenities, car park administration, leasing support, and enhancements for common areas. Its managed portfolio spans various facility types, from government and public buildings to office complexes, industrial parks, and educational institutions.
